{{Quote|Hey, that name rings a bell. Vargaliu. He was a bounty hunter, way back.|[[Mij Gilamar]] on Vargaliu|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
'''Vargaliu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] later turned business owner. He was killed by [[Arla Fett]], sister of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], sometime before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] when she was still part of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
